description: This file defines a final class 'BufferConverter' responsible for converting audio buffers between formats using AVFoundation's AVAudioConverter. It includes internal error handling, a generic Box class for concurrency safety, and a core conversion method that handles buffer format checking, converter initialization, and error checking.

classes.name: BufferConverter
classes.description: A utility class for converting AVAudioPCMBuffer objects between different formats using AVAudioConverter.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts the given AVAudioPCMBuffer to the specified AVAudioFormat, initializing and configuring the converter as needed, and handling conversion errors.
